summary.en: An internal deployment framework built around a server-agent model for environments where client configuration, networking constraints, rollback, and day-two operations matter more than a one-click demo.
summary.id: Framework deployment internal berbasis model server-agent untuk environment yang menempatkan konfigurasi client, constraint jaringan, rollback, dan operasi setelah deployment sebagai masalah utama, bukan sekadar demo satu klik.

contribution.en: Acted as the primary implementer and technical decision-maker for the PoC: architecture, outbound-oriented agent communication, deployment state, configuration and exposure modes, logs/resources, recovery flows, and production pilot setup.
contribution.id: Menjadi implementer utama dan technical decision-maker untuk PoC: arsitektur, komunikasi agent berorientasi outbound, deployment state, mode konfigurasi dan exposure, log/resource, recovery flow, serta setup pilot production.

title: FACETRO
organization: PT Global Data Inspirasi / Universitas Negeri Semarang

summary.en: A face-recognition attendance and access platform deployed across university environments, integrating backend services, ML inference, storage, reporting, and edge devices.
summary.id: Platform presensi dan akses berbasis face recognition yang dideploy di lingkungan universitas, mengintegrasikan backend, ML inference, storage, reporting, dan edge device.

contribution.en: Modularized backend services, developed operational APIs and reporting workflows, integrated Google SSO and protected object storage, and supported the migration from Google Cloud Platform to Huawei Atlas edge infrastructure.
contribution.id: Memodularisasi backend, mengembangkan API dan workflow reporting, mengintegrasikan Google SSO serta protected object storage, dan mendukung migrasi dari Google Cloud Platform ke infrastruktur edge Huawei Atlas.

summary.en: A CV-aware internship prioritization platform that compares a candidate profile against 21,985 opportunities and explains which roles deserve attention first.
summary.id: Platform prioritas magang berbasis CV yang membandingkan profil kandidat dengan 21.985 lowongan dan menjelaskan posisi mana yang paling layak diprioritaskan.

contribution.en: Designed the CV analysis workflow, deterministic prefiltering, recommendation scoring, privacy controls, and static-plus-serverless deployment architecture.
contribution.id: Merancang workflow analisis CV, deterministic prefiltering, scoring rekomendasi, kontrol privasi, dan arsitektur static-plus-serverless.

title: Fingerprint Attendance System
organization: R&D installation at STEKOM Semarang and Universitas Negeri Semarang

summary.en: A standalone local-first ESP32 attendance controller combining fingerprint authentication, local administration, relay control, offline records, and a prototype embedded display.
summary.id: Controller presensi standalone local-first berbasis ESP32 yang menggabungkan autentikasi fingerprint, administrasi lokal, relay control, penyimpanan offline, dan prototipe embedded display.

contribution.en: Designed the firmware architecture, credential and presence workflows, local web administration, real-time state updates, licensing, and prototype LVGL interface.
contribution.id: Merancang arsitektur firmware, workflow credential dan presensi, administrasi web lokal, update state real-time, licensing, dan prototipe antarmuka LVGL.

summary.en: A browser-based bulk domain checker that validates up to 100 names, normalizes RDAP results, supports cancellation and filtering, and exports a clean CSV.
summary.id: Bulk domain checker berbasis browser yang memvalidasi hingga 100 domain, menormalisasi hasil RDAP, mendukung pembatalan dan filter, serta mengekspor CSV.

contribution.en: Implemented input normalization, concurrency, timeout and retry behavior, cancellation, status mapping, filtering, and CSV export without accounts, API keys, or a persistent backend.
contribution.id: Mengimplementasikan normalisasi input, concurrency, timeout dan retry, cancellation, status mapping, filtering, dan ekspor CSV tanpa akun, API key, atau backend persisten.

summary.en: An Indonesian stock recommendation R&D product exploring a disciplined three-part screening workflow across market behavior, company/evidence context, and statistical investability signals without becoming a trading execution app.
summary.id: Produk R&D rekomendasi saham Indonesia yang mengeksplorasi workflow screening tiga bagian: perilaku pasar, konteks perusahaan/evidence, dan sinyal statistik kelayakan investasi, tanpa berubah menjadi aplikasi eksekusi trading.

contribution.en: Designed the modular data and service architecture, experiment workflow, evidence lifecycle, container deployment, and the current scope reduction toward explainable recommendations built from available data.
contribution.id: Merancang arsitektur data dan service modular, workflow eksperimen, lifecycle evidence, container deployment, serta penyempitan scope menuju rekomendasi yang explainable dari data yang benar-benar tersedia.

summary.en: A safety-oriented adaptive cruise control study comparing a canonical baseline with modern Differential Evolution variants under repeated optimization, response, robustness, and safety evaluation.
summary.id: Studi adaptive cruise control berorientasi safety yang membandingkan baseline canonical dengan varian Differential Evolution modern melalui repeated optimization, evaluasi response, robustness, dan safety.

contribution.en: Own the simulation and optimization software, experimental pipeline, statistical auditing, robustness scenarios, visualization, and manuscript engineering analysis.
contribution.id: Menangani software simulasi dan optimasi, experimental pipeline, statistical auditing, robustness scenario, visualisasi, dan analisis engineering pada manuskrip.

summary.en: A comparative collision-avoidance study using DQN, DDQN, and D3QN, presented here as a research collaboration rather than a solo implementation claim.
summary.id: Studi komparatif collision avoidance menggunakan DQN, DDQN, dan D3QN, ditampilkan sebagai kolaborasi riset, bukan klaim implementasi tunggal.

contribution.en: Performed program testing, supported reproducibility preparation, and contributed to technical manuscript writing and copy editing.
contribution.id: Melakukan pengujian program, mendukung persiapan reproducibility, serta berkontribusi pada penulisan teknis dan copy editing manuskrip.

summary.en: A smart aquaculture study combining sensor monitoring and fuzzy logic for interpreting water-quality conditions in tilapia cultivation.
summary.id: Studi smart aquaculture yang menggabungkan monitoring sensor dan fuzzy logic untuk menginterpretasikan kondisi kualitas air budidaya tilapia.

contribution.en: Contributed paper framing, research-design review, reference validation, manuscript conversion and editing, and project administration.
contribution.id: Berkontribusi pada framing paper, review desain riset, validasi referensi, konversi dan editing manuskrip, serta administrasi proyek.
